verdict.rationale: ReadMe generates AI suggestions from your own documentation inside the product. The AI Linter checks pages against natural-language rules. Docs Audit scans the whole site for outdated content, broken links and style issues. The GitHub AI Writer proposes doc updates when code changes. AI Discoverability scores the docs against an agent-friendly spec, and the Agent chat panel helps research and edit content. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights over usage data (API and MCP metrics appear to be plain reports), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestion quality.
